architectural_overview.name: AXIOM AI OS
architectural_overview.description: Autonomous AI operating system with multi-executive board, intelligent routing, workflow orchestration, and founder authority controls
phases: Phase A - Core Intelligence & Executive Runtime
Phase B - Autonomous Executives (Jenson, Valta Prime, Yamako)
Phase C - Autonomous Workflow + Specialist Agent System
Phase D - Quality Control & Founder Authority
Phase E - Executive Intelligence & QC Learning
Phase F - Board Room & Communication Coordinator
core_principles: Architecture Law 1: The Founder is the CEO
Architecture Law 2: Executives never do operational work directly
Architecture Law 9: Intelligence is provider independent
Architecture Law 10: All workflows produce learning

technology_stack.frontend: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Zustand, Framer Motion, Tailwind CSS
technology_stack.ai_providers: NVIDIA (GLM-5.2, Mistral Mamba, Stepfun, General), Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI (GPT-4o), Mock (dev only)
technology_stack.integrations: GitHub, Slack, MT5 (read-only), TradingView (placeholder), Calendar (CalDAV/Google/Outlook), Email (IMAP/SMTP/Gmail), CRM (HubSpot/Pipedrive/Salesforce), WhatsApp (Twilio), Market Data (Polygon/Alpha Vantage/Twelve Data/Yahoo Finance)
technology_stack.deployment: Docker-ready, systemd service configs, environment-based config

directories.config: Centralized path resolver, settings, secrets management
directories.engine: Intelligence, routing, providers, workflow, specialist agents, learning, memory, QC
directories.models: Pydantic models for all domain entities
directories.runtime: Executive loops, lifecycle, founder authority/gateway, board room, schedule coordinator, QC engine

key_components: IntelligenceEngine - Smart model routing with multi-model support
SmartRouter - Task-aware model selection with 4 NVIDIA models + fallbacks
ExecutiveRuntimeLoop - Continuous autonomous cycles for 3 executives
QCManager - 18 check types with intelligence-backed and heuristic checks
FounderAuthority - 10 restricted action categories with audit trail
LearningEngine - Pattern detection, recommendations, knowledge consolidation
ProviderRegistry - YAML-based provider loading with circuit breaker/rate limiting
BoardRoom - Meetings, KPIs, decisions, action items
SystemMonitor/GreetingEngine - JARVIS-style telemetry and boot greetings
useAxiomStore - Central Zustand store with 50+ state slices
VoiceEngine - Wake word detection, WebSocket streaming, speech arbitration
FounderWorkspace - Main dashboard with executive greetings, board room, learning panels

configuration.yaml_files: Organizations, agents, workflows, capabilities, events, departments, executives, memory
configuration.secrets: Environment variables, .env, Docker secret files, future vault support

mocks_found.pattern: Hardcoded JSON response with mock data
mocks_found.details: Returns canned responses when DEBUG=true and REAL_PROVIDERS_ONLY=false. Explicitly disabled in production mode. Used for development/testing only.

mocks_found.pattern: Placeholder implementation with no real API
mocks_found.details: TradingView has no public REST API. All tool implementations call non-existent endpoints. Requires replacement with actual data provider (Polygon, Alpha Vantage, Twelve Data, or tradingview-ta library).

mocks_found.pattern: Default routing rules use only anthropic/openai
mocks_found.details: Default rules hardcoded to anthropic/openai for capabilities like IMAGE_GENERATION, VIDEO_GENERATION, AUDIO, TRANSCRIPTION which these providers may not fully support. Requires proper specialized model registration.
Greeting templates are documentation/examples for the dynamic generation system, not mock data.

mocks_found.pattern: LLM prompt templates with example JSON output format
mocks_found.details: Prompt templates show expected JSON structure for LLM responses. Not mock implementations.

mocks_found.pattern: Abstract base with Yahoo Finance as only concrete impl
mocks_found.details: Polygon, Alpha Vantage, Twelve Data implementations are stubs. Only Yahoo Finance works without API keys. Requires real API keys for production market data.

mocks_found.pattern: Mock wake word detection using keyword matching
mocks_found.details: Uses simple string matching for wake words ('hey axiom', 'jenson', etc.) instead of real audio processing. Production needs Web Speech API or dedicated wake word model.

blockers: TradingView provider is entirely placeholder (no public API exists)
Market data providers (Polygon, Alpha Vantage, Twelve Data) are stub implementations
No deployment manifests (Kubernetes, Docker Compose for prod)
Secrets management relies on .env files only (no Vault/AWS Secrets Manager integration yet)
ready: Core architecture is solid with clear separation of concerns
All 3 executives (Jenson, Valta Prime, Yamako) have full runtime loops
10-phase autonomous workflow engine with approval gates
15+ specialist agent types with capability routing
QC system with 18 check types and rework loops
Founder Authority with 10 restricted actions and audit trail
Multi-model intelligence routing (4 NVIDIA + Anthropic + OpenAI)
Provider registry with circuit breaker, rate limiting, retry logic
Board room with meetings, KPIs, decisions, action items
Schedule coordinator with priority-based conflict resolution
Learning engine with pattern detection and knowledge consolidation
Voice system with wake words, WebSocket, speech arbitration
needs_work: Replace TradingView provider with real market data source
Implement Polygon/Alpha Vantage/Twelve Data market data providers
Add comprehensive test coverage (unit, integration, E2E)
Integrate HashiCorp Vault or AWS Secrets Manager
Implement real wake word detection (Porcupine, etc.)
Add API rate limiting and DDoS protection

strengths: SecretsManager sanitizes all logged data (tokens, passwords, keys, auth headers)
Founder Authority enforces approval for 10 restricted action categories
Provider circuit breakers prevent cascade failures
Rate limiting via token bucket per provider/tool
Circuit breaker pattern with half-open recovery
Audit logging for all tool invocations
concerns: No authentication/authorization on API routes (assumes internal network)
No HTTPS/TLS configuration in code (relies on reverse proxy)
No input validation beyond Pydantic models
Secrets in .env files (no vault integration yet)
recommendations: Add JWT-based auth for API routes
Implement API gateway with rate limiting
Implement audit log persistence with tamper detection

test_coverage.details: No test directories or test files found in backend/axiom/ or dashboard/. No pytest, jest, or playwright configurations discovered.
